content.text:
# Add group and user based on build arguments
RUN addgroup --gid ${GROUP_ID} ${GROUP_NAME}
RUN adduser --disabled-password --gecos '' --uid ${USER_ID} --ingroup ${GROUP_NAME} ${USER_NAME}

# Set user and group of working directory
RUN chown -R ${USER_NAME}:${GROUP_NAME} /var/www/html

# Update and install packages
RUN apk update && apk add \
    bash \
    git \
    gnupg \
    libzip-dev \
    unzip \
    libstdc++ \
    icu-dev \
    pkgconfig \
    libpng-dev \
    libjpeg-turbo-dev \
    libpng \
    libjpeg-turbo \

observation.command:
cd /workspace && cp docker/tooling/tooling.Dockerfile /tmp/tooling.Dockerfile.bak && sed -i 's|^# Copy files from node image$|# Back up the base image libapk before overwriting (node image ships an older
# libapk with the same SONAME, which would break the apk binary)
RUN cp /usr/lib/libapk.so.3.0.0 /usr/local/lib/libapk.so.3.0.0.base

# Copy files from node image|' docker/tooling/tooling.Dockerfile && sed -i 's|^COPY --from=node /usr/lib /usr/lib$|COPY --from=node /usr/lib /usr/lib
# Restore the base image libapk so apk keeps working
RUN cp /usr/local/lib/libapk.so.3.0.0.base /usr/lib/libapk.so.3.0.0|' docker/tooling/tooling.Dockerfile && sed -n '20,40p' docker/tooling/tooling.Dockerfile
